comment: pager.c do_look()'s '/' 'i' path picks from the whole inventory. windows.c select_menu() raises gb.bot_disabled while tty_select_menu() dismisses the corner menu, so wintty.c erase_menu_or_text()'s docorner(offx, maxrow + 1, 0) clears rows 0..maxrow from offx - 1, row_refresh() reprints the map, and its closing bot() returns at once. With three status lines, map row ROWNO-1 lies on terminal row 21, the first status row. ^F maps corridors there, and this pack's (end) footer is on row 20, so docorner() clears and reprints row 21 only. The corridors stay beside the data-base text window; its own dismissal, with bot() enabled, writes status line 1 over them. Variations: whatis-inventory-keeps-map-over-three-line-status-bottom-row, whatis-inventory-clears-status-suffix-two-lines.
